project.title: Crisis Communication Playbook for On‑Site Security Incidents
project.objective: Design and roll out a clear, multi-channel crisis communication playbook for security-related incidents at company sites.
deliverables: Crisis communication playbook covering 5 main incident types
On-site security incident reporting and escalation script
Media and stakeholder holding statements library
Internal staff briefing and training materials
Simulation drill plan and evaluation template
constraints: Playbook must align with legal and safety regulations for security operations
All materials must be understandable by non-specialist on-site staff
Media responses must be pre-approved by legal and compliance teams
Solution must work for 24/7 operations with limited on-site equipment
Initial version must be ready before the next quarterly safety drill
All external messaging must be consistent across languages and channels

risks.risk: On-site staff misunderstand escalation steps during an incident.
risks.mitigation: Create simple checklists, run short trainings, and test with tabletop exercises before rollout.

risks.risk: Media statements conflict with legal or regulatory requirements.
risks.mitigation: Involve legal counsel in template drafting and set mandatory approval workflow.

risks.risk: Inconsistent messaging across spokespersons and channels.
risks.mitigation: Centralize key messages in a shared library and define a clear sign-off process.

risks.risk: Playbook is too complex to use under stress.
risks.mitigation: User-test with security staff, simplify language, and provide quick-reference one-pagers.

themes.why_relevant: Defines how security staff trigger communication workflows during crises.
Spokespersons and PR must align on what to say, when, and through which channels.
Security and public statements must respect law and internal policies.
Staff must practice the playbook so they can follow it under pressure.
Need clear separation and coordination between staff updates and public messaging.
Post-incident reviews refine the playbook over time.

backlog.task: Map typical on-site security incident scenarios and current response gaps
definition_of_done: At least 5 incident types documented with current handling steps
Pain points and communication gaps listed for each scenario
Validated with one security guard representative

backlog.task: Draft crisis communication playbook structure and ownership matrix
definition_of_done: Table of contents agreed by PR and spokespersons
RACI/ownership matrix defined for each incident phase
Reviewed by operations manager and updated accordingly

backlog.task: Create simple incident reporting and escalation script for security staff
definition_of_done: Step-by-step script written in plain language
Script tested with at least two security staff for clarity
Legal and safety teams confirm no conflicting instructions

backlog.task: Develop media holding statements and Q&A templates for key scenarios
definition_of_done: At least one holding statement per incident type drafted
Top 10 likely media questions with suggested answers prepared
Legal counsel signs off on all templates

backlog.task: Design internal staff briefing templates for crisis situations
definition_of_done: Short briefing notes template created for internal updates
Language adapted for non-expert staff comprehension
Pilot briefing tested with small internal group and feedback captured

backlog.task: Prepare training session content for security and front-line staff
definition_of_done: Training deck and facilitator notes completed
Session plan fits within 60 minutes including Q&A
At least one dry run completed with PR or spokesperson present

backlog.task: Define multi-channel communication strategy for crises
definition_of_done: Channels per incident type and severity mapped
Approval flow for social, web, and press defined
Alignment confirmed with spokesperson team

backlog.task: Create quick-reference checklists for use during incidents
definition_of_done: One-page checklist per incident type produced
Font and layout suitable for print and mobile
Reviewed and approved by security operations lead

backlog.task: Set up schedule and format for crisis simulation drills
definition_of_done: Drill objectives and scenarios documented
Timeline and participants list agreed with operations
Evaluation criteria and feedback form prepared

backlog.task: Document post-incident review and improvement process
definition_of_done: Standard review template created
Roles and timing for reviews defined
Process communicated to security and communication teams

backlog.task: Align external messaging with community relations priorities
definition_of_done: Key community concerns identified and listed
Messaging adjusted to address concerns without legal risk
Sign-off obtained from senior management

backlog.task: Consolidate final playbook and distribute to stakeholders
definition_of_done: All sections merged into a single document
Version control and access rights configured
Distribution list confirmed and playbook shared

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on incident scenarios, scope, and playbook structure.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the crisis communication playbook project.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the 4–6 priority incident scenarios to cover in v1 of the playbook.
Confirm the overall structure and owners for each section of the playbook.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define on-site escalation scripts and quick-reference checklists.
threads_plan.trigger: Security-focused member shares first draft of escalation steps for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final version of the on-site incident escalation checklist.
Decide how the checklist will be made available on-site (print, digital, both).

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on media holding statements, Q&A, and channel strategy.
threads_plan.trigger: PR member posts draft holding statements and channel mapping for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the default holding statement for each priority incident scenario.
Approve the multi-channel crisis communication strategy and approval flow.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize internal briefing templates and training approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Secondary school teacher shares draft training materials and briefing templates.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the internal staff briefing template format and tone.
Agree on the training format (live sessions, recordings, or mixed) and schedule.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Close out project with review process and distribution plan.
threads_plan.trigger: Near deadline, team reviews readiness for rollout and next steps.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in on top priorities and blockers for the playbook.
Weekly review thread to track progress against backlog tasks and risks.
Pre-drill coordination thread one week before any planned simulation.
Post-incident or post-drill mini postmortem to capture lessons learned.
End-of-week summary message highlighting decisions and next steps.
